title: Providers expats compare while planning remote or hybrid Dutch work
intro: Remote and hybrid employment in the Netherlands often overlaps with **tax and payroll questions**, **visa and work-authorisation limits**, **relocation timing**, **housing search** and **mandatory health insurance** once an offer is in play. These listings are for discovery when you need scoped help — not a ranking of remote-job boards or coworking spaces, and not tax or immigration advice. Confirm services, pricing and credentials before you commit.
